definitions.explanation: a formal ceremony held at schools to mark the beginning of a new term or semester

examples.japanese: ⟦{新学期|しんがっき}→新学期：16070_shingakki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{始業式|しぎょうしき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The new term starts with the opening ceremony.

examples.japanese: {始業式|しぎょうしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to school early on the day of the opening ceremony.

examples.japanese: {始業式|しぎょうしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{担任|たんにん}→担任：16408_tannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Our new homeroom teacher was introduced at the opening ceremony.

notes:
JAPANESE SCHOOL CEREMONIES:
{始業式|しぎょうしき} marks the start of each term. Japanese schools typically have three terms per year.

WHEN HELD:
- Start of first term (April) - often combined with ⟦{入学式|にゅうがくしき}→入学式：05495_nyuugakushiki⟧
- Start of second term (September)
- Start of third term (January)

TYPICAL ELEMENTS:
- ⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧ - principal's address
- {校歌|こうか}{斉唱|せいしょう} - singing the school song
- ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧ - introduction of new teachers

RELATED CEREMONIES:
- ⟦{終業式|しゅうぎょうしき}→終業式：08554_shuugyoushiki⟧ - closing ceremony (end of term)
- ⟦{入学式|にゅうがくしき}→入学式：05495_nyuugakushiki⟧ - entrance ceremony
- ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧ - graduation ceremony
